Top matches by score v2 Candidates matching your criteria — not a recommendation. Only names whose 0.70–0.80Δ Apr–Jul 2027 call passes the tradability/data gate are ranked, by daily percentile ranks across today's gated names. Tap a card for the breakdown.

How the score works (v2, 0–100)
  • 1. Contract: across the Apr–Jul 2027 expiries, the call nearest 0.75Δ inside 0.70–0.80Δ (IV and delta solved from the bid/ask mid, Black-Scholes, 4% rate, no dividend); if several expiries qualify, the one with the tightest spread.
  • 2. Gate (pass/fail, not points): two-sided quote, spread ≤10% of mid, open interest ≥100, ≥260 daily bars, ≥120 days of IV history. Failing names show “Gated out” with the reason and no score.
  • 3. Score: each input becomes a percentile rank (0–1) among today’s gated names, then weighted: vol cheapness 25 = ln(1-year realized vol ÷ the contract’s IV); 12-month momentum skipping the last month 25; closeness to the 52-week high 15; cost 15 = spread % of mid, lower ranks higher; low idiosyncratic vol 10 = residual volatility vs SPY over 63 days, lower ranks higher; profitability 10 = Yahoo profit margin. An input missing for a row is dropped and its weight renormalised (listed on the card).
  • Display only: support, IV rank, pullback, analyst consensus/targets are context — not in the score, gate or sort.
Prices are prior completed sessions only. The score measures fit to these criteria, not future returns.
